summary: Enterprise AI model aggregators let corporations access multiple foundation models (GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, Mistral, and more) through a single secure, managed API that keeps data within the company's existing cloud or governance boundary. In 2026 there is no single winner — the best fit is usually determined by an enterprise's existing cloud footprint, with AWS Bedrock offering the widest model choice, Azure OpenAI deepest OpenAI integration for Microsoft shops, and Google Vertex AI leading on native Gemini and tooling. Data-platform-native options like Snowflake Cortex and Databricks increasingly bring models to where enterprise data already lives.
why_enterprises_use_aggregators: Data residency and privacy: inference runs inside the enterprise's own cloud tenancy/VPC so sensitive data never leaves the governed environment and is not used to train vendor models.

Single billing and existing cloud contracts: usage rolls into an existing AWS/Azure/GCP enterprise agreement, committed-spend discounts, and one invoice rather than many separate vendor subscriptions.
Compliance and governance: built-in audit logging, access controls (IAM/RBAC), and certifications (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, ISO, GDPR) that individual model vendors may not provide out of the box.
Model choice and avoiding lock-in: a single API abstracts many models (Claude, Llama, Mistral, GPT, Gemini, Nova) so teams can switch or compare models without re-architecting.
Enterprise-grade operations: private networking, VPC endpoints, fine-tuning/customization, guardrails, monitoring, and integration with existing identity, security, and data pipelines.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.pricing: On-demand per-token pricing plus Provisioned Throughput (reserved capacity/model units) for guaranteed throughput; also batch pricing discounts.
key_features: 30+ foundation models behind one API
PrivateLink/VPC access, data stays in account
CloudTrail audit logs and IAM access control
Fine-tuning and custom model import
Bedrock Guardrails, Agents, and Knowledge Bases (RAG)
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already on AWS or those wanting the widest open-source and niche model coverage behind a single secure API.

platforms.name: Azure OpenAI Service (Azure AI Foundry)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-token pricing plus Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs) for reserved capacity; regional and global deployment options.
key_features: Deep OpenAI model integration with enterprise SLAs
VNet/Private Link and regional data residency controls
Azure Monitor audit logging and Entra ID RBAC
Fine-tuning and distillation support
Content filtering, responsible AI tooling, and Azure AI Foundry model catalog
platforms.best_for: Microsoft-first enterprises wanting the latest OpenAI models with Azure governance, identity, and compliance.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI Model Garden
platforms.pricing: Per-token/character pricing for Gemini; capacity reserved via GSUs (Generative AI Scale Units, e.g. ~25 GSUs ≈ 67,250 tokens/sec for Gemini 2.5 Flash); pay-as-you-go for third-party models.
key_features: Native Gemini plus curated third-party model catalog
VPC Service Controls and data residency regions
Cloud Audit Logs and IAM
Fine-tuning, distillation, and grounding/RAG
Integrated MLOps, agents, and BigQuery data integration
platforms.best_for: Google Cloud enterprises wanting native Gemini plus strong data/ML tooling and a broad curated model garden.

platforms.name: Snowflake Cortex AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based using Snowflake credits; billed per-token/compute within the Snowflake account.
key_features: LLMs run directly on governed data in Snowflake
No data movement outside the Snowflake perimeter
SQL and Python functions (Cortex functions, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search)
Role-based access control and access history/audit
Built-in RAG and document AI over enterprise data
platforms.best_for: Enterprises whose data already lives in Snowflake and want AI applied in-place without building separate pipelines.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
platforms.pricing: Per-token (Resource Units) pricing plus subscription/committed capacity; available on IBM Cloud, on-prem, and hybrid.
key_features: Hybrid and on-prem deployment options
IBM Granite enterprise models with IP indemnification
watsonx.governance for model risk, audit, and compliance
Fine-tuning and prompt tuning
Strong focus on regulated industries
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises needing hybrid/on-prem deployment, model governance, and IP indemnification.

platforms.name: Databricks Mosaic AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based (DBUs) for model serving, fine-tuning, and tokens; pay-as-you-go plus committed use.
key_features: Model serving with foundation model APIs
Unity Catalog governance and lineage
Fine-tuning and custom model training on your data
AI Gateway for routing, rate limits, and audit
Lakehouse data + ML integration
platforms.best_for: Data/ML-heavy enterprises on the lakehouse wanting unified governance across data, training, and model serving.

platforms.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI
platforms.pricing: Per-character/per-token on-demand plus dedicated AI clusters for reserved capacity.
key_features: Dedicated AI clusters for isolated capacity
Private endpoints and OCI tenancy isolation
Audit logging and IAM policies
Fine-tuning (e.g., T-Few on Cohere)
Integration with Oracle Fusion apps and database
platforms.best_for: Oracle-centric enterprises (ERP/Fusion/Database) wanting generative AI within their OCI environment.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
available_models: various open-source LLMs and embedding models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use (per neuron / per token) on Cloudflare's global edge network; generous free tier.
key_features: Serverless inference at the network edge (low latency)
AI Gateway for caching, rate limiting, logging across providers
Data localization / regional controls
Integration with Workers, Vectorize, and R2
No infrastructure to manage
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing low-latency, globally distributed inference and a lightweight edge-native AI gateway.
